------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.102
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- Addressing misinformation from previous patch note
- Bug Fixes
- Added Time Limit Feature

------------------------------------------------------------------
ADDRESSING MISINFORMATION FROM PREVIOUS PATCH NOTE
------------------------------------------------------------------

The previous patch notes gave the wrong information on how to
pick the Spread Reaper. Here is the CORRECT information on how
to pick them:

1. Hover over any selectable unit on the select menu
2. Press the teleport button ('x' on Xbox controller)
   3 times in a row while holding the LEFT select
   button (LEFT bumper or trigger on Xbox controller)
3. It will appear that you only selected the selectable
   unit you were hovering over, but you actually picked
   the Spread Reaper in secret...


------------------------------------------------------------------
BUG FIXES
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Fixed Gnird's depth
- Fixed section where you could walk through a wall in Ingot
  Terra
- Fixed bug where you couldn't select the Spread Reaper while
  hovering over the cannon units 

------------------------------------------------------------------
ADDED TIME LIMIT FEATURE
------------------------------------------------------------------

- After 5 minutes an enemy third party will appear in the center
  of the map to destroy both sides (this is to prevent stalemates
  and keep tournament run times consistent)

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.101
notes.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.101
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- Established Main Menu (and balance changes)
- Established Side Menu and implemented Gnometopia units
- Established Secret Menu
- Minor Updates

------------------------------------------------------------------
ESTABLISHED MAIN MENU (and balance changes)
------------------------------------------------------------------

GOAL: To establish a core 15 units that are easy to understand,
      use, and provide a similar base meta to the older patches
      before Queens and Sardines were added in the game.

The following units are to be the established MAIN MENU units
with the following balance changes (if any):
- Fly & Hive 
- Ant & Ant Hill 
- Splare & Portal 
- Gnome 
- Cupcake 
- Bumbler 
- Psy Crab 
    - Increased HP from 20 to 40
- Rorbeetle
- UFO
- Honey Cannon 
    - Increased HP from 20 to 30
- Salt Cannon 
    - Removed Salt Rush ability (for simplicity's sake)
    - Increased HP from 40 to 80
- Garl-ICBM 
    - Decreased HP from 10 to 2
    - Removed friendly fire
        - NOTE: Only Ants are Rorbeetles are immune to garlic

------------------------------------------------------------------
ESTABLISHED SIDE MENU
------------------------------------------------------------------

GOAL: To provide more specialized and technical units to spicen
      up gameplay from time to time. These 5 unit slots will
      rotate from tournament to tournament to help prevent
      scope creep and overwhelming newer players.

The following units are the SIDE MENU Gnometopia units with
the following descriptions:
- Gnole (a defensive land mine)
- Gnurse (a healing spell caster support unit)
- Gnird (a flying Gnome with a weaker explosion)
- Gnirdinator (a spawner for the Gnird)
- Gnome Lord (the gnome "Boss Unit" that has melee attacks but
              goes BOOM upon death, its cost goes down as more
              BOOM attacks connect with your opponent)

------------------------------------------------------------------
ESTABLISHED SECRET MENU
------------------------------------------------------------------

GOAL: To provide a wild card options that encourages people to
      "screen scout" and look at their opponent's screen to 
      avoid a Spread Reaper sneak attack

Spread Reaper 
    - In battle...
        - Doesn't appear on radar
        - Ignore and flies over everything
        - Goes straight towards the nearest enemy Piggy Bank 
          or Spawner 
        - Will chase the enemy Captain if they see them 
        - Will go after the enemy Jar if there is nothing else
          to target
    - How to select...
        1. Hover over any selectable unit on the select menu
        2. Press the teleport button ('x' on Xbox controller)
           3 times in a row while holding the right select
           button (right bumper or trigger on Xbox controller)
        3. It will appear that you only selected the selectable
           unit you were hovering over, but you actually picked
           the Spread Reaper in secret...

------------------------------------------------------------------
MINOR UPDATES
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Bug Fix:          Melee ground troops will no longer walk
                    over walls when clumped up 
- Visual Update:    The red cross is copyrighted so the Gnurse's
                    design was updated to have a red heart
                    instead

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.9
notes.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.9
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- Overall Changes
- Bug Fixes
- How to Select Hidden Units
- Balance Changes 
- New Units 

------------------------------------------------------------------
OVERALL CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

- All buildings spawned lock to a grid
- Ground units are easier to spawn when next to a ledge
- No more armored units
- No more piercing attacks
- Salt Cannon is selectable from the main menu normally again
- Gnole is no longer a secret menu variant to the Gnome
- Koo Koo Squid is now a secret menu variant of the Jellimoa
- Made various performance updates including:
  - Handling unit collisions
  - Drawing team PB and Jelly units to the screen

------------------------------------------------------------------
BUG FIXES
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Removed white lines from stages

------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO SELECT HIDDEN UNITS
------------------------------------------------------------------

- SECRET MENU VARIANTS are now picked by holding the right select
  button ('Right Bumper' for Xbox controllers) then
  pressing the pick button on the menu. You can also see the
  secret menu stats when holding right select.
- The SPREAD REAPER now requires a "cheat code" to select. The
  cheat code is to hold the left select button ('Left
  Bumper' for Xbox controllers) then pressing the the teleport
  button three times in a row ('X' for Xbox controllers) on any
  unit in the select menu. After selected the Reaper it won't
  appear that you have selected it on screen. HOWEVER, this is
  merely to trick your opponent into thinking you selected a 
  normal unit. When you spawn that unit in the battle a Spread
  Reaper will appear instead of the unit you appeared to select.

------------------------------------------------------------------
BALANCE CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

Ant
- No longer Garlicproof

Gnome
- No longer Garlicproof

Rorbeetle
- No longer Stingproof (this ability was removed from the game)

Queen
- Slowed down attack rate from 2 seconds to 5 seconds
- Lowered HP from 100 to 80

Honey Cannon
- Honey goop no longer causes units to take more damage when
  inflicted. The only effect the goop causes is lowering speed
  and attack Rate

Gatling Apple
- Decreased size to fit in grid system

Salt Cannon
- Replaced Bounty Collector ability with Salt Rush ability. Now
  whenever an enemy Captain is taken down from a Salt Cannon your
  Captain will glow white for 5 seconds. For these 5 seconds all
  non-building units have their prices reduced by half for that
  time period

Drone
- Increased cost from $750 to $1000
- Sped up attack rate from 3 seconds to 2 seconds

Termite
- Increased cost from $1250 to $1500
- Removed Sticky-proof and Tough Skin abilities
- Added Sweet Tooth ability which allows Termites to bypass
  the Cloy ability (essentially they can eat through Honey
  Cannons fast)
- NOTE: Termites will remain Garlicproof unlike Ants

Sprost
- Increased cost from $1750 to $2000
- Decreased HP from 20 to 10
- Buffed attack so it instantly destroys all buildings on contact
  including Toast, Salt Cannons, etc.
- Added Nullification ability which negates price debuffs
  (essentially Muffins don't cause Sprosts to go up in price)

Nest
- Increased cost from $3000 to $4000

Termite Mound
- Increased cost from $5000 to $6000

Void
- Increased cost from $7000 to $8000

Tuna in a Can
- Decreased size to fit in grid system

Trick or Treat Bag -> Banana Split
- Was reskinned to be a Banana Split (and is the Side Menu
  counterpart to the Bananalista)

------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW UNITS
------------------------------------------------------------------

Gnird
- Secret menu variant to the Gnome
- Is a slower and less powerful Gnome that can fly

Gnurse
- Secret menu variant to the Gnole
- Casts a spell to heal nearby ally units

Muffin
- Secret menu variant to the Cupcake
- A sturdy wall that makes non-food units more expensive
- TIP: Best paired with other food type units

Grub Father
- Secret menu variant to the Rorbeetle
- Has the bulkiness of a Rorbeetle, the DPS of an Ant, and heals
  itself when inside a garlic cloud. Must hatch from an egg.

YOLO
- Secret menu variant to the UFO
- A much stronger and more extreme verision of the UFO.
  Practically invinsible, but takes 5 minutes to hatch and while
  in egg form it cuts your income in half

Honey Pot
- Secret menu variant to the Honey Cannon
- Lowers the cost of all bug units by 1% per Honey Pot placed
- NOTE: This is very similar to the Hivemind unit from an older
        version of the game

Apple Pie 
- Secret menu variant to the Gatling Apple
- Support unit that gives you double the income that one Piggy
  Bank gives you

Sriracha Cannon
- Secret menu variant to the Garl-ICBM
- Inflicts targets with corrosive goop that causes targets
  to take 50% extra damage (rounding up to the nearest whole
  number) when attacked
- NOTE: The Sriracha Cannon no longer shoots fire attacks like
        it did in previous versions of the game

Pepper Cannon
- Secret menu variant to the Salt Cannon
- Same thing as a Salt Cannon but your captain glows black
  for 5 seconds and reduces the cost of all non-troop units
  by half for that time period

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.8
notes.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.8
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- Unit Select Menu Changes
- **Bonus** How to Select "Secret Menu" Units
- Other Update

------------------------------------------------------------------
UNIT SELECT MENU CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

To prevent the unit select menu from being overwhelming to
newcommers, I hid several units behind the "secret menu".

New "Secret Menu" Units:
- Gnole
- Trick or Treat Bag
- Tuna in a Can
- Salt Cannon
- Spread Reaper


------------------------------------------------------------------
BONUS - HOW TO SELECT "SECRET MENU" UNITS
------------------------------------------------------------------

To select a "secret menu" unit you hover over a certain unit on
the select screen and press the 'X' button (aka the same button
to warp back the jar) (for keyboard it is the '4' and 'L' keys)

- Fly -> Drone
- Ant -> Termite
- Splare -> Sprost
- Hive -> Nest
- Ant Hill -> Termite Mound
- Portal -> Void
- Gnome -> Gnole
- Cupcake -> Trick or Treat Bag
- Sardines in a Can -> Tuna in a Can
- Cannon -> Salt Cannon                 (NOTE: Picking the Salt Cannon
                                                          no longer uses up a slot,
                                                          rather it replaces your
                                                          default Cannon)
- Spread Reaper -> Random Select (NOTE: The Reaper doesn't
                                                           replace any unit, it is
                                                           just EXTRA secret)

------------------------------------------------------------------
OTHER UPDATE
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Reverted the Captain "titles" change. Captains are actual
  characters with names now. The lore of the game will be that
  when a Captain dies the jar will revive them and reconstruct
  their body.

------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.7
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- Bug Fixes

- Balance Changes
- Other Update

BUG FIX
------------------------------------------------------------------

  for Tuna, Drones, Termites, and Sprosts.

------------------------------------------------------------------

  taking out an enemy Captain (normally it is just $1000)

- Increased HP from 2 to 4.

Drone
- Speed up attack rate when nearby Queen.

Sprost
- Decreased cost from $2000 to $1750.

Termite Mound
- Decreased cost from $6000 to $5000.

Void
- Decreased cost from $8000 to $7000.

------------------------------------------------------------------
OTHER UPDATE
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Updated Captain's names to "titles". I wanted to do this
  because lore-wise these aren't characters per say, rather these
  are "classes" or "types of captains" with titles/rankings.

notes.title: VERSION 0.0.0.6
notes.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.6
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- Bug Fix
- Visual/Other Updates
- New Units
- Secret Menu Units
- Balance Changes

------------------------------------------------------------------
BUG FIX
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Fixed "pushing ground units off screen" glitch

------------------------------------------------------------------
VISUAL/OTHER UPDATES
------------------------------------------------------------------
- Added new particle effects for various units, attacks, and
  effects.
- All units either have death animations or leave behind corpses.
- Corpses have physics and can interact with certain objects.
- Captain skeletons/corpses has been updated to break into
  multiple pieces.
- In battle sound effects are randomized to vary in pitch to
  prevent sound repetion from being grating.

------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW UNITS
------------------------------------------------------------------

Trick or Treat Bag
- A "Piggy Bank" that only costs $1000.
- Runs out of candy after 20 seconds & stops earning money.
TIP: Use to gain access to expensive units for an early rush.

Tuna in a Can
- Much like Sardines in a Can... but BIGGER.
- Tunas have 20 HP each
- Tunas have "Fish Eater" ability which allows them to eat ally.
  Sardines to recover HP.
TIP: Pair with Sardines to create an unbreakable, moving meat
     shield.

Spread Reaper
- Only targets Piggy Banks, Spawners, Captains, and the Jar.
- Doesn't appear on the radar.
- Has a delayed spawn appearance. Only appears 5 seconds later.
  in the spot where the Captain initially spawned them.
TIP: Place them every where in every corner to catch your
     opponent by surprise.

Jellimoa
- Casts a spell upon spawning. While casting you temporally stop
  earning money. After casting they move forward like any other
  normal unit.
- Spell is a circular AoE electrical shock wave that causes
  piercing damage to all non-building units. (Does up to 40
  damage).
TIP: Use as a "get off me" option when being rushed by enemy
     melee troops.

Koo Koo Squid
- Casts a spell upon spawning. While casting you temporally stop
  earning money. After casting they move forward like any other
  normal unit.
- Spell is a circular AoE force shield which blocks projectiles
  and negates the effects/damage from enemy AoE attacks. However,
  when hit by a Gnome or Gnole explosion the force field
  disappears.
TIP: You must be precise and strategic with your Squid
     placements. Use it at the very moment you know your forces
     would otherwise be wiped out by an enemy projectile/AoE
     attack.

Gnole
- Gnome + Mole which digs underground to become a land mine.
- Doesn't appear on radar.
- Is able to detect flying units.
TIP: Go out as early as possible to spam these critters all over
     the map. It may be too late to do so later in the game.

------------------------------------------------------------------
SECRET MENU UNITS
------------------------------------------------------------------

"Secret Menu" units are alter-egos of units already in the game.
These units are typically less cost effective and a bit weaker,
but they always have a specialized niche which could prove to be
useful in specific scenarios.

NOTE: These patch notes will NOT explain how to select these
units or share their specific stats. It is up for the community
to experiment how they function. I will provide HINTS though...

Drone & Nest
- Alternative picks to the Fly & Hive
HINT: Try pairing them with Garl-ICBMs or Gnomes...

Termite & Termite Mound
- Alternative picks to the Fly & Hive
HINT: Try using them when Honey Cannons start to annoy you...

Sprost & Void
- Alternative picks to the Splare & Portal
HINT: Try using them when Ants start to annoy you...

------------------------------------------------------------------
BALANCE CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

General Changes
- New ability "Plated Armor" halves damage received from
  projectiles and AoE attacks. (Effectively this means units with
  this ability have double the HP they have in regards to being
  hit by projectiles/AoE attacks).
- Certain projectiles are able to PIERCE which means they bypass
  the "Plated Armor" ability.

Spawners
- (PERFORMANCE) The "Max Unit Capacity" has been lowered from
                300 to 200. This means once there are 200 ally
                troops already on the field, your spawner will
                temporally stop spawning until there are less
                than 200 troops.
                (Clarification: 200 limt means
                each side can up to 200 units, so there can
                roughly be 400 troops on the field at once)

Sardines in a Can
- Increased HP from 10 to 30.

Honey Cannon
- Decreased HP from 30 to 20.

Bananalista
- Their attacks now PIERCE.

Gatling Apple
- Decreased HP from 150 to 100.
- Decreased attack power from 3 to 2.
- Their attacks now PIERCE.

Salt Cannon
- Increased attack power from 5 to 10.

Garl-ICBM
- Garlic radation friendly fire now does full damage to
  allies rather than only half.
- Garlic radation can now PIERCE.

Bumbler
- Their attacks now PIERCE.
- Gained "Honey Combo" ability which causes their projectiles
  to do +5 more damage when hitting a target ensnared with
  honey (normally it is only does +1 damage for other units).

Psy Crab
- Decreased HP from 50 to 20.
- More likely to move forward when clumped up against a wall.

Rorbeetle
- Gained "Plated Armor" ability (see description above).
- Gained "Stingproof" ability which resists Jellimoa's melee
  attack, but NOT their AoE electrical spell.

UFO
- Decreased HP from 150 to 100.
- Gained "Plated Armor" ability (see description above).
- Their attacks now PIERCE.
- Slightly increased width of AoE attack radius.

Queen
- Decreased HP from 150 to 100.
- No longer sacrifices HP to spawn a Fly.
- Doubles the attack speed of all Flies within her cluster.

Gnome
- Their explosions now PIERCE.
- Gained "Garlicproof" ability.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.4
notes.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.4
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- Bug Fixes
- Balance Changes

------------------------------------------------------------------
BUG FIXES
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Fixed Queen's "object index '147'" game crash
- Fixed bug that caused Spawners to stop spawning units when
  outside range of the Cupcake
- Fixed visual bug when selling Sardines in a Can
- Fixed bug where sometimes the game wouldn't return to 60 FPS
  after the jar being destroyed
- Fixed an unintended mechanic where sometimes a Captain would
  still have honey on them even after they died
- Fixed an unintended mechanic where ground troops would be
  pushed over enemy buildings

------------------------------------------------------------------
BALANCE CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

Ant
- Made them more easily target banks while the Captain stands
  next to a Piggy Bank and spawns them

Salt Cannon
- Improved attack rate from 4 seconds to 3 seconds
- Slightly increased the AoE size of its attack

Psy Crab
- Added "Onward" ability which makes Psy Crabs take a few steps
  forward after every 5 spoons they fire

Queen
- Increased HP from 100 to 150

------------------------------------------------------------------
QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGE
------------------------------------------------------------------

Spawners will turn grey when the unit cap is reached and they can
no longer spawn units. However, once the unit cap is no longer
reached they will turn back to normal and start spawning again.

notes.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.3
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- New Menu
- Bug Fixes
- Performance Optimization
- Balance Changes
- Stage Change
- New Captains

------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW MENU, BUG FIXES, and OPTIMIZATION
------------------------------------------------------------------

- New menu has been implemented to give the game a more clean look
  and improve performance
- "Rave Beetle" glitch was fixed (this is what caused units to
  get stuck in a wall when spawned)
- Fixed bug where you could build near a diagonal wall
- Improved performance by using the Yo Yo Compiler (YYC). This is 
  a special compiler for creating executable packages that use
  machine code instead of interpreted code and a runner
- Improved performance by having cannons, battle statitics, etc.
  update less regularly rather than every frame

------------------------------------------------------------------
BALANCE CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

Spawners
- To prevent major fps drops, all spawners will stop spawning when
  there are 300 units from your own team on the field (example: if
  you are team Jelly and there are 10 UFOs, 50 Psy Crabs, 90 Splares,
  and 150 Flies on the field, Jelly Hives will stop spawning Flies
  until there are less than 300 Jelly units on the field)
- You can still spawn units without the spawner even when you surpass
  the 300 unit limit


Sardines in a Can
- Sardine Can and Sardines are no longer garlic-proof
- Sardine Cans now have the "Limited Supply" ability, meaning they
  will stop spawning Sardines after they spawned 15 of them. The
  can will be shown as being empty to indicate this happening.

Psy Crab
- Slowed down attack rate from 3 seconds to 4 seconds

Queen
- Queens now sacrifice 1 HP for every Fly they spawn

Bananalista
- Slowed down ripening time from 5 seconds to 10 seconds
- Slowed down attack rate from 3 seconds to 5 seconds

Gnome
- Decreased max damage from 150 to 100 (this damage calculation
  is only relevant to the UFO match-up, meaning this is more of
  a UFO buff than a Gnome nerf)

Garl-ICBM (aka the Garlic Cannon)
- Decreased maximum damage inflicted from 200 to 150 (like the
  Gnome this is in practice a buff to the UFO)

------------------------------------------------------------------
UPDATED STAGE
------------------------------------------------------------------

Cosmic Ingot
- Used to be called "Cosmic Terra"
- New layout
- Two paths to your opponent: 1. Quick path which is a short
  narrow bridge or 2. Long path which is out of the way, but
  is large and wide open

------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW CAPTAINS
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Berserker (Dtan's avatar)
- Lancer (ZaChuTWO's avatar)
- Mr Gloom (xceinie's avatar)

notes.title: Version 0.0.0.2
notes.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------
PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.2
------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW
- Entire codebase refactored (but players probably won't notice this)
- New win condition
- Quality of life updates
- New units
- Balance changes
- Stage changes
- Visual and sound tweaks

------------------------------------------------------------------
MAJOR CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

New Win Condition
- To win you must take out your opponent's jar AND the final captain remaining
- You can destroy your own jar by triple tapping the sell button while on it
	- You don't earn anything for "selling" your jar

New Menu
- Able to select the "type" of Vs Mode
	- Free Play = Both player pick stage and units at the same time
		- All other modes a coin is flipped to determine who picks first
	- Death Match = Best of 1
	- Best of 3
	- Best of 5

Other Quality of Life Changes
- Made it easier to tell where you can or can't place things in battle
- Showed extra stats such as # of banks, networth of army, etc. at top right of screen in battle

------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW UNITS
------------------------------------------------------------------

Honey Cannon
- Affordable, durable, disrupting cannon unit
	- Does no damage by itself, but causes targets to be ensnared with honey
	- Ensnared targets...
		- ...move slower
		- ...attack slower
		- ...and take 1 extra damage when hurt
	- Captains can be ensnared too
	- "Cloy" makes it resist Ant attacks
- Tips:
	- Try using these as walls in front of your normal cannons
		- (unless you're opponent is using Splares, honey easily melts from fire)
	- Pair these with other units with a high attack rate to maximize damage
	- Use these in micro situations to slow down your opponent Captain

Bananalista (which has replaced the Sriracha Cannon)
- Low HP, long range, sniper "cannon"
	- Needs to ripen for 5 seconds before it can shoot
	- "Harvest" ability gives you an extra 15% money back when selling
- Tips:
	- Due to their low HP, be sure to support them with walls protecting them
	- Try using these to outrange your opponents cannons to lay siege on them

Gatling Apple
- High HP, short range, machine gun artillery
	- Fires 5 bullets per second
	- Each bullet does 3 damage (3x the power of a normal cannon bullet)
	- Needs to ripen for 10 seconds before it can shoot
	- "Harvest" ability gives you an extra 15% money back when selling
- Tips:
	- They are easily outranged so be sure to place them in key locations
	- Pair these with slow, late game units that appreciate good defenses (like UFOs)

Queen
- Expensive, powerful, flying unit
	- Spawns a Fly every 2 seconds
	- "Hivemind" ability causes Flies to swarm around her
	- Takes 20 seconds to hatch from egg to spawn
- Tips:
	- Pair with Hives and/or Flies to maximize the number of Flies to surround her
	- They are susceptible to Splares, so try pairing them with Ants
	- When facing these, be sure to not let them reach critical mass with their Fly count

------------------------------------------------------------------
BALANCE CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

Gnome (which was previously the Boomie Bear)
- Increased maximum damage inflicted from 100 to 150
- Made explosion hitbox more dynamic (changes size during animation)
- Are no longer radioresistant (or garlic-proof)

Spawners
- Due to performance issues, spawners will stop spawning when 100 of their type of unit is already on field

Sardines in a Can
- Decreased can's HP from 30 to 10
- Can and sardines are now radioresistant (or garlic-proof)

Psy Crab
- Fixed "walk into danger without attacking" bug
- Launched spoons are smaller, but lock-on more easily (they still do AoE)
- Launches spoons 1 second faster
- Decreased attack power from 5 to 2

UFO
- Increased HP from 150 to 300
- Increased attack power from 10 to 30

Garl-ICBM (aka the Garlic Cannon)
- Increased garlic cloud duration from 10 to 20 seconds
- Increased maximum damage inflicted from 150 to 200
- Garlic cloud now inflicts friendly fire to ally units (but only does half damage)

------------------------------------------------------------------
UPDATED STAGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

Sino Solas
- New layout
- Larger and "A" shaped

King's Kitchen
- Now plays "For the Holy Land" song

------------------------------------------------------------------
SOUND CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

- Overall volume of sound has been decreased
- Sound effects will be louder or softer in battle depending how close you are to them

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.0.0.1
notes.content:
GOAL OF PATCH
- Adding new content
- Improve the game's visuals
- Improve the game's performance
- Helping make the game "feel" slightly more professional
- Slight balance tweaks

------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW UNIT
------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Sardines in a Can[/b]
- A brand new spawner (like the Hives, Ant Hills, and Portals)
- Also can serve as a defensive wall
	- It has 30 HP, is fireproof, resists Ants, and is essentially
	  a less effective piece of toast with an additional resist
- Spawns Sardines, the weakest of all units in the game
	- Sardines have 2 HP, 1 Speed, and have slightly less attack
	  than Rorbeetles
	- The can itself only costs $1000 and spawns twice as fast as
	  other spawners
- Tips:
	- Can easily get a high number of Sardines in the early game
	  to overwhelm your opponent
	- Sardine Cans are less cost effective & real estate effective
	  compared to other Spawners when it comes to the long game
	- High number of Sardines can act as a regenerating, moving,
	  defensive wall which can soak up projectile attacks

------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW STAGE & IN-GAME MAP
------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Picnic Zone[/b]
- New picnic level
- Name may be subject to change

[b]New in-game map[/b]
- Should help improve performance
- Slightly transparent

------------------------------------------------------------------
VISUAL CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]New in-game color palette[/b]

[b]Default captains have mustaches[/b]

[b]Sriracha Cannon resembles a sriracha bottle[/b]

[b]Salt Cannon resembles a salt shaker[/b]

------------------------------------------------------------------
BALANCE CHANGES
------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Salt Cannon[/b]
- Increased attack power from 4 to 5

[b]Garlic Cannon[/b]
- Renamed to "Nuclear Garlic Cannon"
- Increased AoE radiation cloud attack power from 100 max to 150 max
Tip:
	- Can now 1 shot a group of U.F.O.s

[b]Psy Crab[/b]
- Decreased attack power from 6 to 5
- Known In-Game Bug:
	- Occassionally Psy Crabs will walk into troops without attacking
	- Unfortunately, this will have to be fixed in the next patch

[b]Boomie Bear[/b]
- Decreased attack power from 150 max to 100 max
- Note:
	- No longer 1 shots U.F.O.s

[b]Rorbeetle[/b]
- Rorbeetles no longer resist U.F.O. attacks
- Rorbeetles are now immune to garlic radiation

[b]U.F.O.[/b]
- No longer inflicts "BOOM" based damage
